coverage.basis: Feed door (homepage wix-warmup-data, widgetcomp-kvl1fc9r.events): 14 rows, hasMore false — 13 status 0 (upcoming) and 1 status 1 (the 11 Sept Bear Bash, already over). Second door (the rendered COMING UP strip in the same HTML): exactly those 13 upcoming cards. Third door (event-pages-sitemap.xml, 1068 URLs): every date-stamped slug on or after the recon date is one of the 13, and every undated slug modified since August is either one of the 13 or an unopened page the widget does not carry (5 of them, listed as a trap). Twelve of the 13 event pages were read from the page cache and their JSON-LD dates match their rows one for one (handsome-house-party-28 and get-together not opened). The 13 upcoming rows fold into 11 published things: 3 Horse Meat Disco rows = one weekly series (stated 'Every Sunday'), 9 singles (two Handsome, two LATE BAR — no stated rule — MEN INC, 80:20, DEEP INSIDE, Athena, Get Together), and one 3310 row that is the listed instance of a monthly series whose rule the night's own page states ('last Saturday of every month'). Plus one series the widget does not currently carry a dated row for: Bear Bash, published only as the rule 'Bear Bash is on the 2nd Friday of every month.' on /about-5-4 (11 Sept was the last listed edition). publishedEventCount 12 = 3 series + 9 singles. Past listings: the widget serves none; the sitemap's 1050-odd older pages are history and are not enumerated. Run 20260912-153427 returned the 13 upcoming rows (all bear-dropped) plus a BEAR BASH 2026-10-09 record derived from /about-5-4 (kept).
knownGaps: The five sitemap-only pages modified in August 2026 (athena-43, summer-heat-garden-bbq, deep-inside-4, brut-social-5, closed-for-private-event-1) were not opened; they are absent from a widget whose hasMore is false, so they are treated as past or unpublished rather than fetched.
Bear Bash: no dated row exists for October; the series is asserted from the stated monthly rule and the monthly history in the sitemap, so its expect.extracted is "unknown" rather than true.

traps.label: Warmup row 0 'Bear Bash', status 1, 11 September 2026 at 21:00 – 12 September 2026 at 04:00 (slug bear-bash-16)
traps.why: The night had ended (04:00 BST) nine hours before the page was read, and the site itself no longer renders it: the COMING UP strip starts at Handsome House Party. Only the warmup JSON still carries the row, with status 1 ('started') rather than 0. A reader that trusts the raw row set over the rendered list would publish a finished night; the same row is the last listed edition of the bear-bash series (2nd Fridays).

'Duckie' and 'POP!' have no row anywhere on the site.
